copy.label: Copy image to clipboard
copy.hint: Copies a PNG (or the original bytes) for pasting into another app.

transform.label: Transform and save…
transform.hint: Resize, crop, rotate or flip before saving.

compare.label: Compare formats…
compare.hint: Encodes the image several ways and shows which file is smallest.

inspect.label: Inspect metadata
inspect.hint: Shows embedded EXIF/XMP/ICC data, including any GPS coordinates.

browse.label: Browse page images…
browse.hint: Lists every image on the page with size, type and state.

batch.label: Save all images on this page…
batch.hint: Converts the whole page in one run, with progress and cancel.

scope: Offline original pure-data extraction compared to current source imports; manager commands and migrations tested separately
